description: Returns recent outages for one monitored website: when each started and ended, how long it lasted, and the error. On the Unlimited plan each incident includes an AI diagnosis in plain language; on Free it is marked ai_locked.

days.description: How far back to look. Default 30, max 90.

website_id.description: Monitor id from list_monitors or add_monitor.

name: get_incidents
title: Get outage history for a monitor
